About Us Sea Cliff Court Hotel & Luxury Apartments
EN
ES
Book Now
About Us
Nestled in the serene Masaki neighborhood on the Msasani Peninsula, Sea Cliff Court Hotel Luxury Apartments is recognized as one of Dar es Salaam’s premier accommodation complexes. Our property combines the convenience of a central location with the tranquility of a quiet neighborhood, ensuring a peaceful yet accessible stay.
What We Offer
Luxury Accomodations
We offer 68 luxury serviced suites, including 44 spacious studios, 12 one-bedroom apartments, and 12 two-bedroom apartments, each elegantly decorated with a modern Afro-inspired aesthetic. Most of our furniture and artwork is locally handcrafted, reflecting the vibrant culture of Tanzania.
Online Payment
Stay at home and take an online payment without the use of checks or card
Online Payment

Special Offers
Have special offers to help clients save money and receive special benefits.
Restaurants
The Moyo Restaurant, with its modern wooden interiors and comfortable seating, creates a cozy yet stylish atmosphere. This African Fusion Kitchen & Bar oasis is open daily for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, plus 24-hour room service. Our à la carte menu features a delightful mix of local culinary heritage and international cuisine favorites, accommodating up to 80 guests indoors.
Best location
The location of FT is perfect and very central, so it's convinient for moving.
Friendly Staff
Our staff are helpful. They respond all questions of clients in a happy way.
Facilities & Activities
At Sea Cliff Court, you can take advantage of our well-equipped gym, in-room spa services, a business center, and a swimming pool for relaxation. We are committed to making your stay enriching and enjoyable, with a range of activities designed to introduce you to the local culture, including city tours and visits to the Mwenge Carving Market, Bongoyo Island, and Zanzibar.

Rooms Sea Cliff Court Hotel & Luxury Apartments
EN
ES
Book Now
We blend the comforts of home with the luxuries and services of a top-tier hotel.
Located on the Msasani Peninsula, our apartment complex features 68 lavishly designed luxury service apartments, including studios, one-bedroom apartments, and two-bedroom apartments. Each unit is air-conditioned and decorated in a contemporary style with locally handcrafted wood work and a mixture of modern elements, giving it a simplistic, spacious and comfortable look.
Our apartments offer a refreshing ambiance with numerous amenities, making them ideal for both business trips and holiday stays. The spaces are designed for functionality, ensuring a serene and relaxing atmosphere.
Studio Apartments
These studios are perfect for double occupancy, offering majestic comfort and ease
Learn More
One Bedroom Apartments
These apartments feature a separate bedroom with a double bed, a spacious living room with a sofa bed, a bathroom, and a fully equipped kitchen including a washing machine.
Learn More
Two Bedroom Apartments
Ideal for families or groups, these apartments consist of two separate bedrooms (one double and one twin room), a spacious living room with a sofa bed, a bathroom, and a fully equipped kitchen with a washing machine.
Learn More
The Residence
These fully serviced, one- and two-bedroom apartments are perfect for families or individuals seeking comfort and style. Each unit boasts contemporary decor complemented by locally handcrafted woodwork, creating a spacious and inviting atmosphere.
Learn More
Luxury & Comfort
Additional Amenities
All apartments include ironing facilities, safety deposit boxes, and DVD players with a rich collection of movies available upon request. The entire complex is designed to alleviate travel fatigue by organizing all facilities under one roof, offering you a seamless and luxurious stay.
Experience the ultimate in comfort and convenience at Sea Cliff Court, where every detail is crafted to provide an unparalleled living experience.
